title: Machine Learning Algorithm to Predict Atrial Fibrillation Using Serial 12-Lead ECGs Based on Left Atrial Remodeling
summary: LightGBM used serial ECGs to predict new atrial fibrillation; 415,964 ECGs/176,090 patients, with external validation on 1,000 patients at two hospitals. Reported external AUC .880, sensitivity .810, specificity .822; full Methods/Results read. Retrospective validation, not clinical benefit.
